name: system-info
description: Comprehensive system diagnostic — gathers identity, activations, credentials, storage, network, persistence state, and backs up key files to SD card. Single pass, no flash writes.
author: dspl1236
scripts: sysinfo_dump.sh - Full diagnostic + backup to SD card
notes: v2.0: Consolidated system-info + password-finder + variant-dump + persistence-dump into single comprehensive diagnostic. Uses sed instead of head/tail (not available on QNX). Runs entirely from SD card.
short_description: Complete diagnostic — identity, activations, credentials, nav DB, persistence backup, bus topology. Single pass, no flash writes.
detail: 14-section report: system identity, GEM state, activation/FSC, credentials + sweep, storage, network, installed mods, HBpersistence backup, processes, syslog, nav DB/map/acios_db.ini, credential sweep, CVALUE/FSC file backup, QNX kernel + IPC/DSP/MOST/CAN bus topology. Consolidates system-info + password-finder + variant-dump + persistence-dump + map-parser.
